blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Sullivan Station was little changed, 92 in June and 93 in September (+1.1%), and 29 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 8.3% of Surrey’s 1,120 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Sullivan Station?
Sullivan Station also had 128 condos and townhomes listed and 10 sold in September, against 93 houses listed. The Sullivan Station condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Sullivan Station?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 93 houses listed in Sullivan Station. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sullivan Station a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Sullivan Station had a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Sullivan Station from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 29 houses sold in Sullivan Station over those 4 months, out of 351 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Sullivan Station?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
